title: Now (October 2026)
summary: What I'm doing now. October 2026 edition
content:
Doing...

I hand-delivered the final drawing for St Jude this morning and we're almost halfway through Inktober — I am furious to confirm that practicing actually works and does indeed improve your skills. Some of the art I've done in the past month I'm properly proud of. Jim loved his so much, he framed it.

The Knightlings have been ill on and off for the past month while the weather can't make it's mind up. We've had a couple of hospital visits as well — one for scary breathing-related things and one because Baby Knight the first is clumsy af and had to have her head glued back together.

A few weeks later, the same nurse who did the aforementioned gluing also fixed my finger when I sliced it open sideways with a Stanley knife[1]. Can't imagine why my children are so clumsy, could come from anywhere.

Eagle-eyed people might have noticed I added a single illustration to the home page of some hats. I have some more I'm going to add in the next few weeks.

Making...

Shotbox is the third utility along with Doodle Scan and Favicons To Go in my little webapp trilogy.

I've not made much progress with the self-hosted version of EchoFeed but I do have a solid plan so that should be happening soon. I want to make it as easy as possible to self-host it.

I've made a minimal (~10 lines of CSS, !10 lines of JS) image gallery using the dialog element to showcase the St Jude drawings once they arrive with everyone who donated.

Listening...

  • Still going through Connor Price's back catalog including the tracks he's done with Nic D
  • Czarface Meets Frankie Pulitzer. Frankie Pulitzer is Tom Hardy, which was news to me and he goes hard.
  • Unshatter by Linkin Park. Emily Armstrong was such a great choice.
  • Ekoh, Lø Spirit & Ninth Key are dropping banger after banger in their 2000s-era Linkin Park style. I love it.

Watching...

We've been rewatching My Name is Earl and it's so wholesome. I wasn't sure if it would hold up given when it was made but it really does. It's a damn shame it never got it's final season to wrap everything up.

I'm two episodes into the new Reacher and I'm into it.

Writing with...

  • Pilot Prera pink, F nib with Pilot black ink. I really love writing with this pen.
  • Neon Pink Pentel P205

  1. Americans: I have been informed you might know this as an exacto knife rather than the British generic trademark usage of "Stanley" ⤾
